## 2. Overall Description

### 2.1 Product Perspective

[Project Name] is a [standalone / module of larger system / replacement for X].
It interfaces with [external system A] via [protocol] and [external system B] via [protocol].

### 2.2 Product Functions

High-level summary of primary functions:
- **[Function 1]**: e.g. User registration and authentication
- **[Function 2]**: e.g. Resource creation, retrieval, update, and deletion
- **[Function 3]**: e.g. Reporting and data export
- **[Function 4]**: e.g. Admin management panel

### 2.3 User Classes and Characteristics

| User Class | Description | Technical Level | Frequency |
|-----------|-------------|----------------|-----------|
| End User | Primary consumer of the application | Low | Daily |
| Administrator | Manages users and system settings | Medium | Weekly |
| Developer | Integrates with the API | High | As needed |

### 2.4 Operating Environment

- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+ / Node.js 18+ / PHP 8.1+
- **Operating System:** Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+), macOS, Windows 10+
- **Database:** PostgreSQL 13+ / MySQL 8.0+ / SQLite 3
- **Minimum RAM:** 512 MB (1 GB recommended)
- **Network:** TCP/IP connectivity; HTTPS on port 443 in production

### 2.5 Design and Implementation Constraints

- All API communication must use HTTPS in production
- Passwords must be stored hashed (bcrypt, ≥10 rounds)
- System must comply with GDPR for user data stored in EU deployments
- All timestamps stored in UTC

## 3. Functional Requirements

> Format: **FR-NNN** | **Priority**: Must / Should / Could | **Source**: [code symbol]

### 3.1 Authentication and Authorisation

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Source |
|----|------------|----------|--------|
| FR-001 | The system shall allow users to register with an email address and password | Must | `register_user()` |
| FR-002 | The system shall validate email uniqueness at registration | Must | `users.email UNIQUE` |
| FR-003 | The system shall hash passwords before storage using bcrypt | Must | `hash_password()` |
| FR-004 | The system shall issue a JWT upon successful login | Must | `login()` |
| FR-005 | The system shall reject requests with invalid or expired tokens | Must | Auth middleware |
| FR-006 | The system shall allow administrators to deactivate user accounts | Should | `deactivate_user()` |

### 3.2 Resource Management

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Source |
|----|------------|----------|--------|
| FR-010 | The system shall allow authenticated users to create resources | Must | `create_resource()` |
| FR-011 | The system shall return paginated lists of resources | Must | `list_resources()` |
| FR-012 | The system shall allow retrieval of a single resource by ID | Must | `get_resource()` |
| FR-013 | The system shall allow the resource owner to update a resource | Must | `update_resource()` |
| FR-014 | The system shall allow the resource owner to delete a resource | Must | `delete_resource()` |
| FR-015 | Deleted resources shall be soft-deleted (marked, not removed) | Should | `status='deleted'` |

### 3.3 Administration

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Source |
|----|------------|----------|--------|
| FR-020 | Admin users shall be able to view all users | Must | `list_users()` |
| FR-021 | Admin users shall be able to delete any resource | Must | `admin_delete_resource()` |
| FR-022 | The system shall log all admin actions with timestamp and actor | Should | Audit log |

## 5. External Interface Requirements

### 5.1 User Interfaces

- Web application served as a single-page application (if applicable)
- All forms must validate input client-side before submission
- Mobile-responsive layout (breakpoints at 768px and 1200px)

### 5.2 API Interfaces

- RESTful HTTP API using JSON payloads
- Base URL: `https://api.example.com/v1`
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- See *API Documentation* for complete reference

### 5.3 Database Interface

- Accessed via ORM (SQLAlchemy / Eloquent)
- No raw SQL queries in application code (ORM only, except for complex reporting)
- Connection string stored in `DATABASE_URL` environment variable

### 5.4 External Services

| Service | Purpose | Integration Method |
|---------|---------|-------------------|
| Email SMTP server | Sending notifications | SMTP / SendGrid API |
| File storage (S3 / local) | Media uploads | boto3 / local filesystem |

## 6. System Constraints

- Must deploy on standard Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+) VPS without Kubernetes
- Must run in a Python virtual environment (no system-wide package installation)
- Maximum container image size: 500 MB
- Must operate without root privileges at runtime

## 7. Assumptions and Dependencies

**Assumptions:**
- Users have modern web browsers (Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+)
- The database server is accessible from the application server
- A valid TLS certificate is provisioned for the production domain

**Dependencies:**
- All Python/Node/PHP packages listed in the dependency manifest (`requirements.txt` / `package.json` / `composer.json`)
- External email service for sending notifications
- Database server provisioned and accessible
